Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 81. Category: form. God Forms.

Godly Transformation
Through extreme modifications or merging of other
technologies, you can temporarily become more than
your original design.
Increase your Power by 4
You deal an additional 2d6 to all damage
Increase your Movement Speed by 40 ft.
You gain an additional +2 to your AC
At the end of your turn, you lose 3 Stamina
